# Sample skill

A worked example skill: it carries one supporting script, `check.sh`, and is referred to as
`$sample-skill`, both from a role's instructions and from this file, so that reference is
written differently for each backend when this skill is materialized into a Dispatch's
worktree.

Run `./check.sh` before reporting a role's work as complete. Load `$sample-skill` again if you
lose track of these instructions.
